votes.reason: Accepts complete recorded-input replay, explicit rejection/coverage and effect isolation. Semantics-preserving sanitation and native deadline separation resolve the paired reviewer's vacuity/model-derived-input concerns.

Distinct capacity/retention refusal no longer implies definitive refusal of an old operation. Certified scope retirement or retained equivalent proof preserves floors; Unknown/cleanup remain charged and cannot be aged away. Both scenarios support those guardrails.

Coherent recovery validation and interruption faults refine existing durable mechanisms. The scenarios correctly preserve uncertainty and original clocks instead of treating a checkpoint as action completion.

Correctness equivalence and actual optimization benefit are now separate decisions. The scenario measures recomputation/resources without presupposing an improvement, and cache enablement remains optional after accepted frozen-workload benefit.

Every state/command field must be mapped or explicitly reviewed as quotient/stutter/ghost-only. The new unlisted-field mutation scenario closes partial-observation blind spots while preserving authentication/deadline/outcome relations and the bounded-evidence caveat.

My blocking concern is resolved: malformed/untrusted input produces only bounded allowlisted rejection diagnostics, never fabricated Refused or settlement. Exact authenticated historical receipts have a separate scenario and cannot authorize a replacement binding or renew deadlines.

Protocol-specific authenticated prerequisite evidence replaces a universal Committed requirement; native revalidates exact dependencies at commit. Both restore scenarios retain independent progress without using window commitment to prove preview drainage or presentation.

Received events are admitted only at the legal actor/version/transition boundary; invalid events have no authority, ownership or settlement effect. Refusal-before-adoption and forbidden retirement scenarios support the rule without claiming static session typing.

Admission and transfer are included in accounting; cancellation and release intent cannot discharge charge. The held-reader and pre-adoption-refusal scenarios preserve distinct producer/consumer closure.

Original clock domain/time origin/deadline survive replacement and queueing. Corrected tradeoff permits fail-closed withdrawal of unsent local intent without allowing frontend clocks to authorize, settle or extend native work; both timing scenarios remain sound.

Reviewed outcome text supports localization without adding a translation release gate. Validated Refused classes may use generic text, but unknown schema/outcome cannot fabricate completion; exact unsent and lost-receipt scenarios preserve uncertainty.

My blocking historical-epoch concern is resolved: invalid or unrelated receipts cannot update status, while exact authenticated historical evidence may reconcile retained Unknown through the declared route. Single-owner AT delivery and distinct outcome updates remain qualified native obligations.

Ordinary diagnostics always exclude secrets, credentials, drafts and captured pixels; the allowlist also excludes raw port bodies/titles/arguments/paths. Canary/saturation scenarios preserve privacy, bounded loss accounting and identical authority decisions.

Storage failure and replacement-incarnation geometry cannot clear historical reservations. The corrected scenario preserves each affected operation's existing deadline instead of implying a new recovery deadline; coherent availability still does not establish completion.

Defer implementation/selection of optional local export pending product and frozen assembly/retention policy decisions. I accept the written deferred conditional disposition, no external sending and truthful partial-artifact scenarios; this is not an unresolved safety objection or mandatory release gate.

Focus identity is now enforced throughout the open scope, including activation with no intervening publication. All three scenarios preserve exact native AT-focused targets, press-time identity and the chosen disabled-control fallback policy without confusing selection and focus.

Stable accessible naming, transient state/description and native cross-document relationships are explicit. Three scenarios separate semantic coherence from announcement counting under012 and keep previews inert after retirement.
Composition generation and current field identity constrain committed text; consumed Enter cannot also launch. The delayed retired-field commit supplies a meaningful negative case.

Readability and reachability remain governed by measured frozen policy, not screenshots or tokens alone. Hotplug fallback and constrained reflow scenarios preserve native identity and keyboard usability.

Unaccepted repeated input is neither queued nor replayed. Four scenarios preserve independent eligible controls and dependency-stable picker identity, truthful Pending feedback and keyboard recovery without requiring concurrent native transactions.
Submission, presentation and retirement have separate identity-matched evidence. Image load/frameSwapped and stale-output receipts cannot prove replacement-transaction completion.

Coalescing remains identity-scoped and control/cleanup capacity remains reserved. Corrected close scenario does not impose global blocking: another authorized demand may use independently free capacity, while held reservations and their cleanup stay accounted.

Native last-presented geometry and approved reduced-motion profile retain operation semantics. Queued-but-unpresented reversal and live preference change preserve original deadlines and retirement boundaries.
Same-machine budgets and minimally observed runs qualify actual presentation/resource spans with missing stages disclosed. This adds no paper-derived timing thresholds and preserves missed samples.

Separates proof identity from delivery continuity and permits known-safe idempotent Ack retry. Cross-entry proof interleaving and lost-Ack scenario correctly avoid false gaps or repeated physical cleanup.

Over-budget route rejection is conditional on actual measurement. Qualified alternatives/unavailable disclosure do not erase mandatory native source-stop/family evidence; no async implementation is imposed.

Latest revision means native-tracked content only, with frozen pacing and bounded demand. Three scenarios cover final update, close/lock/source replacement and continuous-change pacing without forced allocation, first-job deadline renewal or a new fidelity claim.
Explicitly separates live source from old captured pixels, honoring frozen historical/live/unavailable policy. Revocation remains native and cannot leave eligible revoked pixels.

Native taskbar-focus qualification preserves the existing P5 delivery priority, with only early feasibility allowed. Both scope scenarios retain lock inertness, exact eligible return targets and existing MRU policy without choosing a new shortcut.

Disabled actions retain declared position and cannot dispatch through any input route. Reasons/navigation follow frozen per-surface policy and right-click amendment; the scenarios retain native unavailable semantics and dismissal without requiring every disabled action to be focusable.
